    """Overlay the two panels separated by a solid divider; mark overlaps."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # ARC panel separator is a uniform row or column.
    sep_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0), None)
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        top = grid[:sep_row]
        bottom = grid[sep_row + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        return [[2 if top[r][c] != 0 and bottom[r][c] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
                 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("No uniform separator found")
